title: How We Diagnosed and Fixed the 2023 Voyager 1 Anomaly from 15 Billion Miles Away
summary: JPL's David Cummings presents at the 2025 Flight Software Workshop how the team diagnosed and fixed the 2023 Voyager 1 anomaly from billions of miles away. It walks through the flight computer and the memory fix.
why: Commenters recommend it for the remarkable remote reverse engineering done on decades-old hardware with no simulator.

quote.text: Blows my mind of the reverse engineering done to achieve this
